exposure: previous breastfeeding experience of the mother
outcome: Full breastfeeding rates at 6 months postpartum
cohort: 847 women from five tertiary maternity hospitals in Greece
finding: Breastfeeding initiation, duration, and full breastfeeding rates at 6 months postpartum improved during the COVID-19 pandemic period in Greece, potentially due to lockdowns, home confinement, and teleworking.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly correlated with breastfeeding indicators at different time periods.
